purpose: Freeze components that D1 must not present as novel after reconciliation of W03-W08.

entries.component: Layer-jamming / laminar-jamming variable-stiffness architecture in soft machines and robots
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim layer jamming, laminar jamming, or variable-stiffness continuum/soft-robot use as novel in principle.
entries.rationale: Direct layer-jamming systems and robot implementations predate the current candidate.

entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim vacuum-controlled stiffness tuning of stacked layers as novel.

entries.component: Coulomb interlayer friction and pressure-dependent slip mechanics
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim the use of Coulomb friction, frictional stiffening, or pressure-dependent interlayer slip as a new mechanism.

entries.component: Pre-slip, partial-slip, and gross-slip/stick-slip regime concepts and slip-onset thresholds
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim identification of stick/slip regimes or slip onset itself as novel.

entries.component: Physical bending experiments and load-deflection / hysteresis validation for layer-jamming beams
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim physical testing, model-vs-experiment comparison, force-deflection validation, or hysteresis measurement of layer-jamming beams as novel by itself.

entries.component: Discrete layer-by-layer analytical models for slipping layered beams
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim discrete slipping-layer beam modeling or interface-by-interface slip tracking as novel.

entries.component: Continuum / homogenized modeling of layer-jamming structures
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim creation of a continuum or homogenized layer-jamming model as novel.
entries.rationale: Zhang-type continuum models are the baseline M1, not the contribution.

entries.component: Multi-layer partial-interaction / interlayer-slip beam and plate theory
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim that multi-layer or N-layer partial interaction is generally absent from prior art; such formulations exist outside vacuum jamming.
entries.rationale: W07 directly invalidates the overbroad historical wording that partial-interaction work is predominantly only two-layer.

entries.component: Layer-resolved or full-contact FE / numerical reference models
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim use of explicit-contact or layer-resolved numerical models as a novel method by itself.

entries.component: Quantitative reduced-model versus higher-fidelity reference comparison
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim the generic act of comparing a reduced/continuum model with a higher-fidelity numerical reference as novel.

entries.component: Validity / breakdown / applicability-boundary analysis in layered or contact mechanics generally
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim that validity-domain or breakdown-boundary analysis is novel as a general mechanics methodology.

entries.component: Use of numerical error metrics or percentage tolerance thresholds
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim an error metric or a percentage threshold itself as novel. The ca46dc062d 5% threshold is prior art and was reconciled as post-hoc rather than predeclared.
entries.caveat: A priori freezing remains a governance requirement for D1, not a standalone novelty claim.

entries.component: Attribution of stiffness loss or hysteresis to interfacial slip/friction in general
entries.scope_locked_statement: D1 must not claim the generic causal statement that interfacial slip/friction causes stiffness degradation or hysteresis as novel.
